deg_counts.definition: padj < 0.05 AND |log2FC| >= 2.0 in the contrast (ADR 0071); a gene is a DEG when any declared contrast passes, collapsible per gene

method.collapse: one probe per gene symbol: the probe with the maximum mean expression across the 8 selected CM libraries; probes with no gene symbol or a multi-symbol annotation (containing "///") are not used
method.contrast_direction: positive log2FC = up in the patient DCM iPSC-CM arm vs the normal iPSC-CM arm within the same treatment stratum
method.model: limma on the deposited log2 matrix (moderated t)

non_genetic_model_basis: patient-derived DCM iPSC-CM lines compared with normal iPSC-CM lines; no mutation was introduced and no isogenic control is deposited, so this is the clinical (non-mutation-modelled) iPSC-CM form that ADR 0071 admits to nHF tier 2

probe_collapse.rule: one probe per gene symbol: the probe with the maximum mean expression across the 8 selected CM libraries; probes with no gene symbol or a multi-symbol annotation (containing "///") are not used

sensitivity.note: an item-local sensitivity fit of the untreated 2 vs 2 stratum only; it is not a declared contrast of the published dataset
sensitivity.why: the untreated 2 vs 2 stratum is the primary disease contrast

series.assay: one-colour Affymetrix Gene 1.0 ST array (RMA log2 expression)
series.exclusion_reason: the deposit also profiles fibroblast, H7 hESC and undifferentiated iPSC lines; only the cardiomyocyte libraries carry the disease contrast
series.patient_vs_control: patient-derived familial-DCM iPSC-CM lines vs normal iPSC-CM lines; not isogenic and no causal variant is declared in the deposit, so genotype and line identity are confounded (recorded, not corrected)
series.platform_title: [HuGene-1_0-st] Affymetrix Human Gene 1.0 ST Array [transcript (gene) version]
series.title: Expression data from patient iPSC and iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes

strata.decision: the deposit is a 2x2 genotype x Serca2a gene-therapy design; both genotype contrasts are declared and collapse per gene by maximum effect (ticket-01 rule), not averaged into one main effect
strata.why: the Serca2a treatment is applied symmetrically to both genotypes, so each treatment stratum carries a valid DCM-vs-normal contrast; the untreated stratum is the primary disease contrast and its DEG count is recorded as a sensitivity in the tracked summary
